{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Obi-Wan's Journal'' (newsletter)}}
{{Hatnote|For the card, see [[Obi-Wan's Journal]].}}
'''''Obi-Wan's Journal''''' was a newsletter designed by the [[Players Committee]] and offered in the download library of [[swccgpc.com]], in the category "Obi-Wan's Journal (Newsletters)".<ref name="pc-dl7-07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=7 Downloads: Obi-Wan's Journal (Newsletters)], swccgpc.com (24 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153258/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=7 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-dl10-08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=10 Downloads: Player Articles and Newsletters], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105749/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=10 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Issues ==

{| class="wikitable"

|-
| #1 || Initial Release - The Huge Issue || 23 October 2006 || 657<ref name="pc-dl7-07" />

When the Players Committee relaunched swccgpc.com in September 2008, its new download library listed "Obi-Wan’s Journal – Issue 1", posted on 24 September 2008, as an "Old PC Designed Newsletter" in the Player Articles and Newsletters category, beside issue 1 of [[dGamer]].<ref name="pc-dl10-08" />
